text:
anya: Quick note: hit a puzzling SSE behavior in the Rust SDK quickstart where resumed streams sometimes glue two events into one. Repro is intermittent and tied to short client read_timeouts + auth refresh.

ben: can you paste the fragments you captured? sounds similar to other reports but want to see exact boundary shapes.

anya: here's a trimmed capture from our test proxy: we saw the client hold a partial trailing line and then the resume chunk started without the blank-line separator.
```
# before timeout
chunk1: "id: 11\nevent: delta\ndata: part-one-"
chunk2: "part-two\n\n"
# client times out and reconnects with Last-Event-ID: 11
chunk3 (resume): "id: 12\nevent: delta\ndata: next-full\n\n"
```
If the client had a partial buffer ending with "part-one-" and naively concatenates chunk3, we end up with "part-one-part-twoid: 12..." which the parser treats as data -> garbled event.

kai: rust parser uses a byte-scan for CRLF/LF delimiters and only emits on double newline. On resume we weren't clearing the partial byte buffer. Also we don't dedupe by id on resume.

anya: workaround for customers: increase stream_timeout and set reconnect_backoff to 600ms. But we should fix SDK: on reconnect with Last-Event-ID=X, drop partial buffer and ignore frames with id <= X.

ben: small gotcha: some servers don't include id on every event. For those streams we should fall back to sequence numbers or use a small TTL-based dedupe. But better to prefer id when present.

kai: plan: 1) on resume, snapshot last_seen_id; 2) flush any partial line buffer (drop it) before feeding resumed bytes to parser; 3) if incoming frame has id <= snapshot, drop it; 4) add unit test simulating resume that sends a resumed chunk overlapping the tail.

devtools: note: add an integration stress job that runs 100 parallel rust quickstart clients with randomized token latency and proxy chunk-splitting. Mark flaky if > 1% dup rate.

ci-bot: ci: build #2026.11.05-73 showed flake in tests/sse_resume_rust.rs (1/30). https://ci.redwood.example/2026/11/05/73

ben: thanks. kai, can you PR the three-line fix and the tests? Keep change small so we can backport.

kai: yes. PR will: drop partial buffer on resume; add id-based filter; and include a reproducer in examples/rust/stream-resume-repro.

anya: once merged, let's run the stress job and then propagate the note to quickstart docs (recommend larger timeout for now).

ben: also add a short note in SDK parity doc that Rust now matches JS/py dedupe-on-resume behavior.

anya: I'll file a follow-up to audit mobile and native SDKs for the same pattern. Thanks! :pray:
